test_policy.notes: SAT/ACT scores are optional for first-year applicants; the First-Year page says they can be used to determine eligibility for the Merit Award (SAT 1100 or ACT 25 with a 3.3 GPA, or a 3.7 GPA). IPEDS (fall 2024) lists admission test scores as not considered.

requirements.notes: Apply with ApplyMaine or the Common App. The application fee is not stated on the pages read. First-year documents: official high school transcript (sent by a school representative); essay, recommendation letters and test scores are optional. International applicants must send a credential evaluation (NACES or AICE member, must include a GPA; WES or Incred recommended) unless exempt (high school transcripts from China and English-speaking provinces of Canada). UMPI also has a separate fully online, competency-based YourPace program for international students; this file describes the on-campus path.

deadlines.label: Non-Canadian international freshman: application and I-20 document deadline (fall entry)
deadlines.notes: The page lists July 15 for fall 2026 (semester begins Sept. 3, 2026) and Nov. 15 for spring 2026 entry; no fall 2027 table is published yet, so no 2027 date is recorded. Expect a mid-July date and confirm with umpi-admissions@maine.edu; allow time for the I-20 and visa.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Proficiency is shown by: (1) being from a listed English-speaking country (e.g. Australia, Canada, Ghana, Ireland, Jamaica, Kenya, New Zealand, Nigeria, South Africa, United Kingdom; passport copy required); (2) a test score; or (3) instruction in English: a high school transcript stating English was the language of instruction for all subjects, or 2+ years of in-person, non-ESL study at an accredited college in the U.S., Canada or England. Scores must be from the last 2 years and sent by the testing agency.

english.notes: Minimum before Jan. 21, 2026; paper-based TOEFL 550. TOEFL Essentials needs 8.5.
Page: minimum of 4 for TOEFL iBT as of Jan. 21, 2026. It does not name the 1-6 scale, but 4 is the post-January 2026 score (79 applied before).
Cambridge C1 Advanced is accepted; no numeric minimum is printed.

aid.notes: Merit Awards apply to international students, renew each year and need no extra application: $5,000 for first-year (fall) applicants straight from high school with SAT 1100 or ACT composite 25 plus a 3.3 high school GPA, or an overall 3.7 GPA; international applicants must provide official transcripts for all 4 years of high school. FAQ: scholarships do not apply to the online YourPace program for international students. International need-based aid is not described.

cost.notes: UMPI 2026-27 estimated cost of attendance: Maine/Canadian tuition $8,370; out-of-state/international $14,220 (30 credits); mandatory fees $1,500; housing and food $11,400; books $1,000; miscellaneous $1,100 plus travel $1,350. Total is the sum of those listed items at the out-of-state/international rate (the page prints $27,120 direct costs). The Financial Matters page still quotes $15,378 tuition and fees (the 2025-26 figure)

sat.note: Page prints 'UMPI Institution Code: 3008' for scores sent from the College Board or the TOEFL/IELTS site.

act.note: No ACT code is printed; pick the school by name at act.org.

toefl.note: Same institution code (3008) printed in the English proficiency section.

ielts.note: No IELTS code is listed; scores can be sent to umpi-admissions@maine.edu.
